source.exclusion_rule: arms matching /sov|meok-tuned|csoai-tuned/i are excluded before comparison (board rule C-2026-0915-01, as the public board serves it)
source.method: per arm: raw accuracy over its rows; Wilson 95% CI (z=1.959964); each arm vs the top arm by exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs; SEPARATED_LEADER only if the top arm is separated from EVERY other arm at alpha=0.05; TIE_BAND = the test cannot separate the arm from the top; SEPARATED = the arm sits significantly below the top. Exact accuracy ties share a rank and are never broken by anything but the exact McNemar test.

excluded_axes.jail: a model-comparison axis on the served board with NO published per-item rows in this dataset; never ranked here
